# Aporia contrast report

Generated by `build.mjs` from `tokens.json`. 327 gated pairs, 0 failures.
Ratios are WCAG 2.2 relative-luminance contrast on opaque sRGB values. Real-host QA (Helix, Zed, VS Code, Ghostty, Kitty, GitHub) is still pending.

## Exemptions

- **ink terminal.ansi-0**: Background slot by convention (iron). Printed black-on-coal stays low contrast in every dark terminal theme.
- **both interactive.disabled-fg**: Disabled is the only state allowed to reduce contrast.
- **ink accent.brand**: Canonical red on coal is 2.52:1. Ornament and marks only; text uses accent.text.
- **both border.decorative / border.soft**: Decorative hairlines. Never the only boundary of a control.
